cases.name: al-md-0.25
cases.motion:
&MOTION
  &MD
    ENSEMBLE NVE
    STEPS 40
    TIMESTEP 0.25
  &END MD
  &PRINT
    &RESTART OFF
    &END RESTART
    &RESTART_HISTORY OFF
    &END RESTART_HISTORY
    &TRAJECTORY
      &EACH
        MD 1
      &END EACH
    &END TRAJECTORY
  &END PRINT
&END MOTION
